FN-8JMQHHF-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 138
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 138 as introduced provides for the continuance of the State of Alabama Plumbers
and Gas Fitters Examining Board until October 1, 2028 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law.
This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
